name: estimate_colored_object_geometry_3d
summary: Estimate support-relative center, height, footprint axes, and extents for a dominant-color tabletop object from calibrated RGB-D.

generality.rationale: It supports varied rigid tabletop shapes and sizes, but segmentation is restricted to a fixed HSV color vocabulary and assumes a visible horizontal support.
assumptions: One target object is the largest connected component of the requested color.
The camera is calibrated in world and its depth is registered to color.
The object rests on a locally horizontal visible support surface.
limitations: Cannot separate touching same-color objects or handle arbitrary language categories.
Visible-surface footprint estimates can be biased by severe occlusion or specular depth.
Does not estimate a full mesh, collision volume, or stable grasp contacts.

level.rationale: It composes color grounding, calibrated depth projection, robust support estimation, center correction, and footprint PCA.

composition.strategy: Extend color-grounded RGB-D points with support-relative prism geometry needed by object-agnostic grasp planners.

provenance.failure_gap: Qwen localized block surface points but lacked object center, support height, dimensions, and a closing direction for grasp planning.
evidence: iter_001 localized all blocks but then guessed arm joint vectors
